policy: A source may be used for model training only after its current terms, upstream rights, attribution requirements, storage, and redistribution restrictions have been reviewed and explicitly approved.

sources.notes: Version 4.0 effective 2026-10-01 expressly permits internal research, backtesting, model development/evaluation and ML training, and permits derived outputs if raw data cannot be reconstructed. Still requires review of upstream third-party rights and applicable jurisdiction; do not mark approved yet.
Public API docs describe access and rate limits but do not establish a training/data-retention license. Obtain written permission or published terms covering historical storage and model training.
Exact provider, API host and governing terms are not identified in repository metadata. No training use until provider identity and terms are documented.

Published terms require one application/domain and attribution, and restrict use after cancellation; they do not expressly grant historical dataset retention or model training. Obtain written clarification before training use.
